Đưa các vật gần nhau và cân đối hơn. Ghi chú nguồn chỉ là tham khảo: Recognizable picture review candidate. Every outline segment is a guided movable stick. Different outline cuts change passage and release order. >=20 items after campaign position 20. No bomb/chain. R target is retained as reference for GD; Special>=21 prioritizes picture and >=20 items per user decision.
Runtime repair: widened existing open arcs to160 degrees while retaining icon, ring count, fixed width and physically mounted pins; must re-validate, solve, replay and ablate.
